brief: Compare three agent marketplaces and supply independently reproducible public instructions for each. Submit the comparison, citations, relevant source excerpts and a reproduction transcript as public text artifacts. The gross escrow is 50 OUSD. The evaluator fee is zero for this demonstration.

milestones.rubric: Pass only if the submission compares three named marketplaces, cites a specific public source for each and backs each comparison with the submitted source evidence.
Pass only if a stranger can follow one procedure for each marketplace using public inputs and the transcript supports each result. Any procedure requiring private credentials fails this milestone.
